mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_market_data (id, stock_code, stock_name, open_price, close_price, high_price, low_price, volume, amount, trade_date, change_rate) VALUES (#{id}, #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{openPrice}, #{closePrice}, #{highPrice}, #{lowPrice}, #{volume}, #{amount}, #{tradeDate}, #{changeRate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_name = VALUES(stock_name), open_price = VALUES(open_price), close_price = VALUES(close_price), high_price = VALUES(high_price), low_price = VALUES(low_price), volume = VALUES(volume), amount = VALUES(amount), change_rate = VALUES(change_rate)

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_market_data WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1
